v2_roadmap: Ed25519 cryptographic signing of dataset (replaces SHA-256 hash only)
Public key published to repo + Keybase
Per-report signature (every Deep Dive Report gets its own signature)
Verification endpoint: GET /verify/{report_id} returns signed computation chain
Integration with CIRS engine: every score includes hash of inputs + algorithm version
_provenance_meta.disclaimer: v1 uses SHA-256 hashes for integrity verification. v2 will add Ed25519 cryptographic signing for non-repudiation. Both are designed so that any modification to a data point can be detected by recomputing the hash and comparing to the signed original.
